title: The True Messiah Now Appears
description: The True Messiah Now Appears in Tonic Solfa to ST. FLAVIAN, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book II, composed on divine subjects, hymn 12, headed “Christ is the substance of the Levitical priesthood”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Common Metre (8.6.8.6). This page sets the words to ST. FLAVIAN; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: The true Mes-si-ah now ap-pears, The types are all with-drawn; So fly the sha-dows and the stars Be-fore the ris-ing dawn.

lines: So fly the shadows and the stars
No smoking sweets, nor bleeding lambs,
Incense and spice of costly names
Would all be burnt in vain.
Aaron must lay his robes away;
When God himself comes down to be
He took our mortal flesh to show
For us he paid his life below,
And then he shews his open'd veins,

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to ST. FLAVIAN by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
